h1: The 6 Best Freestanding Room Dividers of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six freestanding room dividers compared on width, weight, hinges, feet and wheels for studios, offices and shared bedrooms.
summary: The SUNALLY 4-panel with lockable wheels is our top pick, because it is the only divider here that rolls. The Legacy Decor shoji is the authentic wood option, the MAYOLIAH covers the widest span at 120 inches, the HOMSCREENER adds 88 inches on wide feet, the RHF rattan is the budget boho pick, and the RANTILA is the lightest at 8.8 lbs.
intro: A freestanding divider has one job, to stay upright, and many fail at it. Narrow feet, thin frames and heavy panels are what make a screen topple, so the foot design matters more than the fabric.

We reviewed eight dividers on paper, comparing width, height, weight, feet and hinge design from the spec sheets, and ranked the six that cover the main uses. Prices appear as buckets because they shift often.

products.name: SUNALLY 4-Panel Room Divider with Lockable Wheels
products.verdict: An 88 inch screen with lockable wheels and widened feet.
products.description:
The SUNALLY is a 4-panel divider, 88 inches wide and 72 inches tall, built from 240g polyester over a powder-coated steel frame. It has lockable wheels and extended, widened feet.

It takes the top slot because it is the only one in this ranking that rolls, which matters in a room whose layout changes. The tradeoff is cost, since it sits in the $50-100 bucket.

It suits shared rooms and home offices that get rearranged. The caveat is that wheels add hardware, so lock them when it is in place.
products.skipIf: The divider stays in one place.

products.name: Legacy Decor 6-Panel Shoji Room Divider
products.verdict: A solid wood shoji screen, 105 inches wide at 22 lbs.
products.description:
The Legacy Decor is a 6-panel shoji screen, 105 inches wide and 71 inches tall, with a solid wood frame and translucent panels. It needs no assembly, uses two-way hinges and weighs 22 lbs, the lightest 6-panel wood screen in this set.

It ranks second because wood and translucent panels give real furniture appeal, at the cost of the wheels and fabric flexibility of the SUNALLY. It is in the $100-200 bucket.

It suits a living room where looks matter. The caveat is the higher price.

products.name: MAYOLIAH 6-Panel Folding Privacy Screen
products.verdict: A 120 inch span that reconfigures from 2 to 6 panels.
products.description:
The MAYOLIAH measures 120 inches wide and 72 inches tall across six panels, using 180g polyester on an iron powder-coated frame. It has wider support feet, a 1-year warranty and 5 configuration options from 2 to 6 panels.

It lands third because it covers the widest span of any pick, which makes it the choice for large rooms, though its 180g fabric is lighter than the SUNALLY's 240g.

It suits open-plan spaces. The caveat is that a 120 inch screen needs room to stand.

products.name: HOMSCREENER 4-Panel Fabric Room Divider
products.verdict: An 88 inch fabric screen on 17.7 inch feet.
products.description:
The HOMSCREENER is a 4-panel divider, 88 inches wide and 71.3 inches tall, with 240g polyester on a steel frame. It has triple-buckle hinges, 17.7 inch wide feet and a wrinkle-resistant fabric.

It ranks fourth because it matches the SUNALLY on width and fabric weight but has no wheels, so it is less flexible in a changing room. The wide feet are a real stability plus.

It suits a fixed spot like a bedroom corner. The caveat is the fixed position.
products.idealFor: A fixed bedroom or studio corner.

products.name: RHF 6 ft. 4-Panel Rattan Room Divider
products.verdict: A rattan-style boho divider for under $50.
products.description:
The RHF is a 4-panel divider, 63 inches wide and 72 inches tall, with a rattan-style frame and woven fabric panels. It uses two-way hinges, needs no assembly and has a 5-medallion diamond weave pattern. Cost stays under $50.

Fifth place follows since at 63 inches it covers less width than the fabric screens, but it is the cheapest decorative option here.

It suits a boho bedroom or corner. The caveat is the narrower span.

products.name: RANTILA Single Large Panel Room Divider
products.verdict: A single 71 inch panel at just 8.8 lbs.
products.description:
The RANTILA is a single large panel, 71 inches wide and 69.5 inches tall, with an HDPE and steel frame, UV-protected waterproof fabric and 4 stiffeners for stability. It weighs 8.8 lbs, the lightest here. Cost also stays under $50.

Sixth place is the result since a single panel does not fold, so it is less versatile than the multi-panel screens. Its low weight and waterproof fabric are what set it apart.

It suits buyers who move a divider often or use it outdoors. The caveat is that it does not fold flat like a hinged screen.
products.skipIf: You want a folding hinged screen.

whatMatters.detail: Feet are the base that keeps the screen upright. Wider or extended feet resist tipping. Look for foot width in inches, such as 17.7 inches on the HOMSCREENER.
More panels cover more width but need floor space. Divide your needed span by the listed width. A 4-panel 88 inch screen suits most rooms.
A lighter screen is easy to move but can feel flimsy. A heavier wood screen stays put. Compare stated weights like 8.8 or 22 lbs.
Wood, steel and rattan-style frames differ in look and durability. Steel resists bending. Check the materials line.
Lockable wheels let you reposition, and two-way hinges let you fold either direction. Look for these terms in the bullets.

faq.q: Will a freestanding divider tip over?
faq.a: Wide feet help. The HOMSCREENER lists 17.7 inch feet and the SUNALLY has widened feet. Keep screens on flat floors.

faq.q: Do any of these have wheels?
faq.a: Only the SUNALLY, with lockable wheels. The rest are fixed.

faq.q: Is the Legacy Decor worth it over a fabric screen?
faq.a: If you want solid wood and a shoji look, yes. Fabric screens are cheaper and more flexible.
The Legacy Decor and the RHF both list no assembly required.
Yes, it reconfigures from 2 to 6 panels with 5 layout options.

faq.q: Can I use the RANTILA outdoors?
faq.a: It lists UV-protected, waterproof fabric, so it suits patios. Check the manufacturer page for limits.

finalTake: The SUNALLY 4-panel is the best freestanding divider for most rooms, thanks to lockable wheels and widened feet. Pick the Legacy Decor for wood, the MAYOLIAH for the widest span, and the RHF for a boho look on a budget.
